name: io.github.PugarHuda/nota
title: Nota
description: Four read-only crypto research skills that return RYO's public envelope, plus every decision receipt as a resource. Recomputes RSI(14) and ATR(14) from public candles with Wilder's method, checks a price against three exchanges, reads Telegram, Bluesky and X voices for narrative convergence, and corroborates a claim against dated headlines. A value that could not be fetched stays null and is never replaced with zero.
